description: A web‑based point of sale system for a grocery/retail store with inventory, supplier, customer, reporting and role‑based access.
backend_brief: Create a Flask app with SQLite persistence using Flask‑SQLAlchemy. Define models: User(id, username, password_hash, role), Product(id, name, sku, category, cost_price, selling_price, stock, reorder_threshold), Sale(id, receipt_number, datetime, cashier_id, total, tax, discount, payment_method, customer_id nullable), SaleItem(id, sale_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, line_total), Supplier(id, name, phone, outstanding_balance), GRN(id, supplier_id, datetime, total_cost), GRNItem(id, grn_id, product_id, quantity, cost_price), SupplierPayment(id, supplier_id, datetime, amount), Customer(id, name, phone, due_balance), Setting(key, value). Implement authentication with Flask‑Login and role‑based @login_required and @roles_required decorators. Provide REST‑style JSON endpoints: /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, /api/dashboard (today sales, transactions, profit, low‑stock list, top‑5 weekly), /api/products (GET list with search/filter, POST add, PUT edit, DELETE), /api/products/<id> (GET detail), /api/sell/search (query param q), /api/sell/complete (POST cart, discount, tax%, payment_method, cash_received, optional customer_id) – validate stock, calculate totals, generate sequential receipt_number, update stock, create Sale and SaleItems, adjust customer due if pay‑later, return receipt data. /api/grn (POST create GRN with line items – increase product stock, increase supplier outstanding), /api/suppliers (CRUD), /api/suppliers/<id>/payments (POST record payment – decrease outstanding), /api/customers (CRUD), /api/reports/sales (GET with date range params – totals, profit, daily aggregation), /api/settings (GET/PUT). Return appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages. Use SQLAlchemy session handling, migrations, and environment config for secret key.
frontend_brief: Build a single‑page UI using Tailwind CSS and vanilla JavaScript (or a lightweight framework). Layout: left vertical sidebar with icons linking to routes (Dashboard, Sell, Inventory, Suppliers, Reports, Customers, Settings) and top bar showing store name (from settings), current date, logged‑in user and logout button. Dashboard page displays cards for today's total sales, transaction count, profit, a low‑stock table, and a top‑5 weekly products list; fetch data from /api/dashboard. Sell screen: large searchable input that calls /api/sell/search on each keystroke, shows filtered product cards; clicking a card adds the item to a right‑hand cart panel. Cart rows show item name, quantity with +/- buttons and numeric input, unit price, line total; allow per‑sale discount (percentage or fixed) and tax percent (from settings). Show subtotal, tax amount, discount, grand total live. Payment method selector (Cash/Card); if Cash, show amount received input and auto‑compute change. "Complete Sale" button posts cart data to /api/sell/complete, handles validation errors (e.g., insufficient stock) and shows toast notifications. On success, display printable receipt modal with receipt number, date, items, totals, cashier name, and a print button. Inventory page: searchable, sortable table of products; Add/Edit product opens a modal form with validation (non‑negative prices/stock, required fields). Low‑stock rows display a red badge. Suppliers page: list with outstanding balances, buttons to create GRN (modal with line‑item rows), and to record payment (modal). GRN modal updates stock via backend. Customers page: list with due balances; Add/Edit customer via modal. Reports page: date‑range picker (preset today/this‑week/this‑month + custom); fetch from /api/reports/sales; show summary totals, transactions table, and a bar chart (Chart.js via CDN) of daily sales. Settings page (admin only): form to edit store name, currency symbol, default tax %, default reorder threshold; submit to /api/settings. All pages enforce role‑based UI hiding: hide Inventory, Suppliers, Reports, Settings links for Cashier role. Use fetch API with JWT or session cookie for auth, display toasts for success/error, and ensure touch‑friendly large buttons on Sell screen. Responsive design for tablet use.
